task: Comprehensive Mac Mini local optimization pass. Irtiza wants a thorough performance & usability tune-up now that the machine is ~1 year old. (3) Photos & Screenshots — organize, find duplicates, suggest archival targets (external drive, cloud). (6) Performance tuning — verify Gatekeeper + XProtect status (native security), check for memory hogs, disk I/O patterns, thermal management. (7) Hidden macOS features — document useful built-in tools (Spotlight shortcuts, accessibility features, gesture controls, quick actions) in a summary doc. EXPLICIT: do NOT install third-party AV or ad blocker (macOS native tools suffice); do NOT delete user files without explicit Irtiza approval; do NOT make system changes Irtiza hasn't OK'd. For anything uncertain, flag on issue #1 before making changes. Report before/after metrics (disk space, free RAM, startup item count, cache size, etc.) and document any changes made.
